question: For which feedforward ReLU architectures can parameters be locally identifiable up to neuron permutation and positive scaling, and how prevalent are additional hidden symmetries at initialization?

key_findings.claim: Every architecture whose hidden layers are at least as wide as the input has a positive-measure set with no hidden symmetries.
key_findings.evidence: Theorem 4.1 constructs parameters satisfying a transverse pairwise-intersection condition and a linear-regions condition; openness then promotes the construction to positive measure.

key_findings.claim: Hidden redundancy arises through several distinct geometric mechanisms, not only dead neurons.
key_findings.evidence: The paper catalogs stably inactive neurons, adjacent neurons that are never co-active, parameters expressed only in clipped-away regions, and hidden-layer images confined to positive-codimension affine subspaces; Proposition 5.1 formalizes the last as a continuous hyperplane ambiguity.

anchors.section: 5 Mechanisms by which hidden symmetries arise

key_findings.claim: Depth strongly lowers the observed probability of maximal functional dimension under the chosen initialization.
key_findings.evidence: Across 5,000 initializations per architecture, widths 5/10/15 have maximal dimension in 25/48/66% of depth-4 networks but only 1/3/5% of depth-6 networks when input dimension grows with width.

key_findings.claim: The apparent width trend depends on whether input dimension changes with width.
key_findings.evidence: When input dimension and width increase together, maximal dimension becomes more likely; with input dimension fixed at five, it decreases slightly with width. Thus width alone does not support the abstract's simpler directional summary.

key_findings.claim: Jacobian-rank experiments certify full dimension when they hit the upper bound but otherwise only provide lower bounds.
key_findings.evidence: Functional dimension is approximated by ranks of gradients at a finite Gaussian point set. A deficient numerical rank can reflect undersampling or conditioning, so it cannot by itself enumerate or prove a hidden symmetry.

method.core_idea: Study the fiber of the parameter-to-function map using bent-hyperplane geometry and local functional dimension.
method.mechanism: Prove an open geometric construction with only known permutation/scaling symmetries, enumerate mechanisms that create continuous extra fibers, and estimate Jacobian rank over many random initializations and architectures.
assumptions: Fully connected feedforward networks use ReLU
Genericity and supertransversality describe almost-all parameters
Finite evaluation points approximate local functional dimension
Numerical ranks are stable under the selected tolerance

techniques.role: Provides geometric conditions for recovering parameters up to known symmetries.
Measures independent local function perturbations rather than raw parameter count.
Links rank deficiency to inactive, non-coactive, clipped, or low-dimensional hidden geometry.

evaluations.setting: depth 4--6 fully connected ReLU networks, widths/input dimensions 5, 10, 15, 5,000 initializations each
evaluations.metric: estimated functional-dimension distribution and fraction attaining its theoretical maximum
evaluations.result: maximum fraction falls sharply with depth and depends jointly on width and input dimension
evaluations.baseline: architecture-wise theoretical maximum after known scaling symmetry

limitations: The main theorem establishes existence and positive measure, not typicality under training.
Experiments examine initialization only and scalar-output fully connected networks.
Rank below the upper bound is not a complete symmetry diagnosis.
Some bottleneck architecture families remain unresolved.
failure_modes: Dead or never-coactive neurons create flat parameter directions.
A low-dimensional hidden image makes downstream hyperplanes non-identifiable.
Numerical rank tolerance invents or hides degeneracy.
Optimization in raw parameter space counts functionally equivalent directions as distinct.
reusable_insights: Report functional dimension alongside parameter count when studying local model complexity.
Separate universal permutation/scaling symmetries from parameter-specific hidden ones.
Vary width and input dimension independently in architecture studies.
open_questions: How does functional dimension evolve during training?
Does SGD prefer low-functional-dimension fibers and does that predict generalization?
Can hidden symmetries be quotient out efficiently in optimization and model merging?

competitive_landscape.title: Reverse-Engineering Deep ReLU Networks
competitive_landscape.difference: Rolnick and Kording recover certain networks from bent region boundaries up to isomorphism; this paper constructs a broader positive-measure architecture class satisfying related intersection conditions and studies failure mechanisms.

competitive_landscape.title: Functional dimension of feedforward ReLU neural networks
competitive_landscape.difference: Grigsby et al. define inhomogeneous functional dimension and realization-map fibers; the reviewed paper uses that quantity empirically and links deficiencies to explicit geometric symmetry mechanisms.
competitive_landscape.source_version: arXiv v2/Advances in Mathematics record checked 2026-08-23

competitive_landscape.title: Git Re-Basin: Merging Models modulo Permutation Symmetries
competitive_landscape.difference: Git Re-Basin aligns trained networks using neuron permutations to enable weight-space merging; this paper shows that permutation and scaling need not exhaust function-preserving directions at particular parameters.

novelty_assessment.author_claim: The work substantially broadens architectures known to contain parameters without hidden symmetry and empirically maps architecture-dependent functional dimension.
novelty_assessment.evidence: A positive-measure theorem, four mechanisms, and 5,000-initialization distributions support complementary theoretical and empirical contributions.
novelty_assessment.reviewer_inference: The theorem is a meaningful identifiability result; the initialization trends are exploratory and should not be generalized to trained convolutional or transformer networks.

reviewer_notes: Read all 27 extracted pages, emphasizing theorem hypotheses/proof, four mechanisms, numerical rank protocol, both width controls, supplement, and conclusions. Primary arXiv/PMLR competitor records were checked.
